changelog: Fix: wg-watchdog must not bounce unused WireGuard when IPSec is the live path
Fix: dns-watchdog must not restart dnsmasq when an external DNS probe fails
Fix: GeoIP must ACCEPT OpenVPN 1194 on WAN (SSH/GUI stay dropped; IKE/WG still peer-locked)
Fix: web filter DoH/QUIC only on LAN→WAN, not tun0 / site-to-site, and do not restart dnsmasq on boot
Fix: DHCP relay to remote AD (VLAN iface, IPSec routes not stolen by WireGuard, dnsmasq must stay up)
